queries: NVIDIA 2026 receivables customer payment credit losses quarterly October 2026

sources_considered.why: Primary quarterly filing describes customer payment terms and the cash-flow effect of extended terms.
Secondary interpretation was unnecessary once the underlying company filing was available.
Secondary discussion of receivables does not replace primary evidence of actual customer delinquency.

evidence_items.locator: Notes to condensed consolidated financial statements, customer concentration and payment terms
evidence_items.explanation: The surrounding disclosure permits longer agreed payment terms for certain investment-grade customers and attributes part of receivables growth to those terms. That establishes financing and collection timing, but does not establish customers failing to pay when due.

unresolved_gaps: No cited record establishes material customer payment failures after publication and by the evaluation date.
The filing does not provide a complete customer-level delinquency history.
No earnings effect attributable to an established payment-failure episode can therefore be assessed.
The forecast leaves the earnings metric and accounting basis unspecified.
